note: Original contracts written for this project (not copies of upstream code). Each is the correct form of a pattern whose vulnerable twin is in truth.json. Any finding on one of these is counted as a false positive.

controls.why_safe: state updated before the external call, plus a reentrancy lock
pull-payment refunds; a reverting bidder only blocks themselves
owner set in constructor, two-step transfer, receive() reverts
authorization uses msg.sender; tx.origin appears only in an event
delegatecall to an immutable target with fixed calldata and matching layout
no randomness; block.timestamp used only for day-scale deadlines
balance checked before an unchecked subtraction that cannot underflow
token call results checked, balance-delta accounting, reentrancy lock
two fixed tokens, internal reserves, min-out, token validation
price is stored by the seller; no callback to the caller for any value
explicit allowlist instead of a code-size check
exact length, exact selector, bounded decoded value
